worldpresetpack.presets.title: Choose a World Preset
worldpresetpack.presets.skyblock.desc: Void Overworld and Nether. Start on a small island with a chest.
worldpresetpack.presets.oneblock.desc: One block at spawn. Break it — another appears. Phases from Plains to the End.
worldpresetpack.difficulty.easy.desc: A larger island and a bit more starter loot. Still Skyblock — no free iron or cobble.
worldpresetpack.difficulty.classic.desc: The original island and chest. The intended Skyblock start.
worldpresetpack.difficulty.hard.desc: A tight island and a sparse chest: buckets, ice, one sugar cane, and obsidian.
worldpresetpack.structures.on.desc: Overworld and Nether structures spawn, farther apart than vanilla. The End is unchanged.
worldpresetpack.structures.off.desc: No Overworld or Nether structures. Villages, fortresses, and loot must wait for traders — or stay locked.
worldpresetpack.biome.void.desc: Every Overworld biome is The Void. Structures cannot generate.
worldpresetpack.biome.vanilla.desc: Vanilla Overworld biomes. Your island climate follows the world seed.
worldpresetpack.biome.fixed.desc: The island starts in this biome (weather and mobs). Farther out, the Overworld is still the vanilla mix. The Nether is unchanged.
worldpresetpack.config.title: Skyblock Configuration
worldpresetpack.oneblock.config.title: OneBlock Configuration
worldpresetpack.oneblock.pace.slow.desc: Phases last longer. More of each biome before the next.
worldpresetpack.oneblock.pace.normal.des: Classic OneBlock rhythm. Break the block — a new one appears.
worldpresetpack.oneblock.pace.fast.desc: Phases fly by. Chests and mobs still show up on the same cadence.
